summary: Iteration 27 (frontend-only re-test of iteration_26 fixes on /admin/inventory, PIN 520003, 28 active products). VERIFIED FIXED: (1) Controlled Available/threshold inputs — after '+ Batch' (qty 7) the Available cell immediately showed 62 (was 55), no stale value; after deleting the batch the cell refreshed instantly; (2) Batched-row Available input is disabled with title='Managed by batches'; threshold stays editable and Save persists it (5 -> 8, survived full page reload); (3) Summary vs table consistency — 'Total inventory' card = 28 == 28 table rows; 'Out of stock' card = 0 and filtering shows 0 rows (no card-vs-empty-table mismatch); 'Low stock' card 0 == 0 filtered rows; (4) No React 'unique key prop' console warning anywhere (Fragment key fix works); (5) Badges render as '⚫ Out of Stock' (dark), '🔴 Low Stock' (red), '🟢 In Stock' (green) — observed 🔴 Low Stock and 🟢 In Stock live, 'Disabled' badge on disabled row. Regressions all OK: add-batch dialog persists batch number/qty/expiry, expandable batch panel lists batch with per-batch expiry status ('🟢 Normal · Expires in 125 days'), delete batch works, summary cards set the status filter, sort by nearest expiry / lowest stock, search by product name and by batch number, enable/disable toggle round-trip, Copy PIN target dropdown populated. NEW HIGH BUG FOUND: on a row that has BOTH legacy (non-batch) stock and a batch, clicking Save silently destroys the legacy stock because the backend recomputes available = sum(batches) only. Repro: Almonds available 55 (0 batches) -> add batch qty 7 -> available 62 (correct, additive) -> press Save (only threshold was edited) -> available becomes 7 (55 legacy units lost) -> delete the batch -> available 0. Data restored via API (Almonds back to 55 / threshold 5 / 0 batches).

critical.issue: For rows with batches, available_quantity is recomputed as sum(batches) only, ignoring the legacy non-batch stock that POST /admin/inventory/batch added on top of ($inc available by qty). Result: any Save on such a row (even a threshold-only edit) silently wipes legacy stock (55+7=62 -> 7). Fix by tracking a legacy/unbatched remainder (available = legacy_remainder + sum(batches)) or by migrating legacy stock into an implicit batch when the first batch is added.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows Available 62 before Save and 7 after Save with only a generic 'Updated' toast — user gets no warning that stock was reduced. Even after the backend fix, the UI should surface that Available is derived from batches.

issues: Expiry date uses the browser-native <input type="date"> picker instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere

action_items: Fix PUT /admin/inventory so legacy (unbatched) stock is not destroyed when a batched row is saved — the add-batch path is additive while the save path is batch-sum-absolute; make both consistent.
Optional: when the first batch is added to a row with legacy stock, convert the legacy quantity into a 'LEGACY' batch so the ledger is the single source of truth.
Optional: replace native date input in Add Batch dialog with the shadcn calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory.py: add_batch does $inc available_quantity while upsert_inventory sets available = sum(batches); these two models of truth conflict and cause silent stock loss.
delete_batch's min(batch_qty, available) clamp still hides drift (available reached 0 after deleting a 7-unit batch on a row that originally held 55).

The only open defect is the legacy-stock loss on Save for batched rows (backend PUT /admin/inventory). Test product used: Almonds (Badam) product_id 443e2b02-e4d2-4a35-98b0-e04111a89803, pincode 520003, restored to 55/5/0 batches. To re-verify the fix: add a batch of 7 to a legacy row with available 55 (expect 62), press Save, expect available to stay 62; then delete the batch and expect 55.
rca_of_the_issue: routers/inventory.py upsert_inventory: `if existing and existing.get('batches'): available = sum(b.quantity)` — the batch ledger does not include pre-existing legacy stock, while add_batch increments available on top of legacy stock. Therefore for mixed rows the Save path drops the legacy remainder (55 units) permanently, and the subsequent batch delete drives available to 0.
